stories.title: Five Buss siblings 'united' in selling Lakers shares
stories.summary: Five of the six members of the Buss trust say they are "united" in their intention to sell their remaining shares in the Lakers, despite pushback from Jeanie Buss.

stories.title: Marte in Phoenix after no-show for knee testing
stories.summary: Ketel Marte, who was placed on the restricted list after failing to show up to Monday's game, has traveled back to Phoenix for tests on his left knee, D-backs manager Torey Lovullo said.

stories.title: Sources: Edwards wins QB battle, to start for UNC
stories.summary: North Carolina has named veteran transfer Billy Edwards Jr. as the Tar Heels' starting quarterback for the opener against TCU in Ireland, sources told ESPN.

stories.title: Chiefs' Bieniemy: Wife on 'great road to recovery'
stories.summary: Chiefs offensive coordinator Eric Bieniemy said Tuesday that his wife, Mia, is on track to make a full recovery after she was allegedly shot by the couple's son last month in the family's home in Virginia.

stories.title: 'I'm here to win': Miller has big plans as Cowboy
stories.summary: Thrilled to be with the Dallas Cowboys on a one-year contract, Von Miller, 37, spoke to reporters on Tuesday at training camp in Oxnard, California, and the club will work the veteran linebacker into practice slowly, giving him time to acclimate.
